title: תְּפִלָּה לִימֵי בְּחִירוֹת | A Prayer for Election Days, by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer (2026)
author: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

coauthors.name: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
coauthors.bio: From a family of musicians, Isaac Gantwerk Mayer believes that creative art is one of the most powerful ways to get in touch with the divine. He composes music and poetry in Hebrew and English. (He also translates and transcribes Hebrew and Aramaic texts, adding niqqud and t'amim as needed.) Isaac runs a Jewish music transcription service, which will transcribe and set any Jewish music in any language, recorded or written. Contact his service on Facebook or via his music blog.

excerpt: A prayer for election days to be included in the daily Amidah.
content:
Source (Hebrew) Translation (English)
To be inserted before the חתימה of ברכת המשפט, or else שומע תפילה.
הַנּוֹתֵן מֶמְשָׁלָה לְמוֹשְׁלִים
וְשִׁלְטוֹן לְשׇׁלְטָנִים
וְאַחְרָיוּת לָאֶזְרָחִים
הַמֵּקִים שׁוֹפְטֵי צֶֽדֶק
וְהַמַּשְׁפִּיל עֲרִֽיצֵי רָֽשָׁע
הוּא יְבָרֵךְ וְיָאִיר וְיַשְׂכִּיל
וְיִתֵּן חׇכְמָה וּבִינָה
בְּלִבּוֹת כׇּל־מַצְבִּיעֵי הָאָֽרֶץ הַזֹּאת
בְּיוֹם הַבְּחִירוֹת הַזֶּה
לְהַצְבִּֽיעַ וְלִבְחֹר לָהֶם
מֽוֹשְׁלֵי־צֶֽדֶק וְשֽׁוֹלְטֵי־יֹֽשֶׁר
שֶׁיַּעַבְדוּ וְשֶׁיַּעַמְלוּ וְשֶׁיִּפְעֲלוּ
בְּעַד טוֹבַת הָאָֽרֶץ
וּבְעַד טוֹבַת הָעָם
וּבְעַד טוֹבַת כׇּל־בָּאֵי הָעוֹלָם.
May the One who grants governance to governors
and rule to rulers,
and responsibility to citizens,[1] credit to Stephen Belsky for suggesting this line 
who raises righteous judges
and lowers wicked tyrants,
bless and illuminate and enlighten
and grant wisdom and understanding
in the hearts of all the voters of this land
on this day of elections,
to vote and choose for themselves
just governors and upright rulers,
who will work and toil and labor
on behalf of the good of the land
and on behalf of the people’s good
and on behalf of the good of all who go about on earth.
וְלֹא כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִים
הֶעָרִיצִים וְהַמֻּשְׁחָתִים
לֽוֹקְחֵי־שֹֽׁחַד אַנְשֵׁי־חָמָס וּבְנֵי־בְּלִיַּֽעַל
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַֽרְנוּ בְּלֵב שָׁלֵם בִּימֵי דִּינֵֽנוּ
כִּי תַּעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
But not so for the wicked,
the tyrants and the corrupt,
takers of bribes, men of violence, lowlife ones,
as we said wholeheartedly in the days of our judgment:
“for You will wipe away the arrogant regime from the land.”[2] in the Amidah for the Yamim Noraïm 
תְּנֶֽנּוּ שֶׁנָּקִים וְשֶׁנַּעֲמִיד שׁוֹפְטִים יְשָׁרִים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ
וּבְעֵינֵי כׇּל־רוֹאֵֽינוּ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ —
שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְשֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים תִּֽתֶּן־לְךָ֙ בְּכׇל־שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ
אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לִשְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ
וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם מִשְׁפַּט־צֶֽדֶק׃ (דברים טז:יח)
Grant us that we raise and bring up judges upright in Your eyes
and in the eyes of all who see us,
as is written in the words of Your teaching:
“Judges and rulers you will grant yourself in all your gates
that the Cause your God gives you for your tribes,
and they will judge the people righteous judgment.” (Deuteronomy 16:18)
וְעַל־יְדֵי מַלְכְּךָ מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ שֶׁבּוֹ בָחַֽרְתָּ כָּתוּב —
וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ
הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ (תהלים ב:י)
And by the hand of Your anointed king who You chose it is written:
“And now, kings, be enlightened,
and be warned, rulers of the earth.” (Psalms 2:10)
וּבְדִבְרֵי נְבִיאֶֽיךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר —
וַיָּ֥קֶם יְהֹוָ֖ה שֹׁפְטִ֑ים
וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיע֔וּם מִיַּ֖ד שֹׁסֵיהֶֽם׃ (שופטים ב:טז)
And in the words of Your prophets it is written, quote:
“And the Cause raised judges
and they saved them from their despoilers.” (Judges 2:16)
כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ לְזַעֲקַת הָעָם
וְיִוָּדַע בְּכׇל־יְצִירֶֽיךָ
שֶׁמֶּֽלֶךְ אוֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפַּט אָֽתָּה׃
For You hear the cry of the people,
and it will be known among all Your creatures
that a Sovereign who loves righteousness and judgment are You.

 

Notes

Notes
1 credit to Stephen Belsky for suggesting this line
2 in the Amidah for the Yamim Noraïm
